title: AAOS Heartbeat Projection
description: A DERIVED read-only projection — never independently emitted.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version. Consumer: tools/validate.py (rejects a mismatched major version with a pointer to docs/MIGRATIONS.md).

derived_at.description: Consumer: expire-leases.py (a stale projection is itself suspect) + project-notion.py STALE stamp.

last_run.description: Nullable; null means unknown. Consumer: dead-agent logic.

source.description: One or more upstream signals this projection was read from, e.g. ["notion:35c6ecd8 last_edited_time", "automation-health-monitor:beacon-table"] — an agent may have more than one upstream source (ADR-0005). Consumer: OPERATIONS.md traceability + audit that no new emitter was created.

status.description: Consumer: expire-leases.py (only missed/unknown + expired lease triggers reclaim+escalate); projection color.

threshold_hours.description: The upstream's own threshold (e.g. 16 for cowork). Consumer: dead-agent logic + audit (shows the threshold was inherited, not invented).
